item.author: The Verge (@theverge.com)
item.description:
Plug-in solar isn’t going to replace utility-scale solar farms or 10kW rooftop arrays, but it fills the missing bottom layer of the clean energy transition.

Beyond the savings, I like that I’m reducing my contribution to climate change, and that feeling’s invaluable.

item.title: GUYS. GUYS. MY DUMBASS CAT THAT HAS BEEN MISSING FOR *EL…
item.author: ResistDoc (@aquatixwitch.bsky.social)
item.description:
GUYS.

GUYS.

MY DUMBASS CAT THAT HAS BEEN MISSING FOR *ELEVEN MONTHS* CAME HOME TODAY.

I PUT UP FLYERS. SHE'S CHIPPED. I CALLED ARL. I POSTED ON NEXTDOOR.

This dumbass was living across the street in a cat box the neighbors keep for the local feral cat colony. THE WHOLE TIME.
